snippet.title: Way of the Hunter - Hunting Season One Trailer | PS5 Games
snippet.description:
https://store.playstation.com/concept/10003862/

Experience Hunting Season One on Way of the Hunter with our physical edition which combines the base game and all Season One DLCs.

Experience four large hunting grounds and 45 different animal specials with a wide selection of rifles, crossbows, shotguns, and bows, as well as a sturdy off-road car or agile UTV.

Hunting Season One includes:
- Way of the Hunter base game
- Aurora Shores DLC
- Tikamoon Plains DLC
- Hunter’s Pack DLC
- UTV DLC
